title_lines: Administrative and selling expenses were reduced to Rs. 233.331 million from Rs. 305.439 million in the prior year,
reflecting continued cost discipline across the Company's operations.
Other income for the year amounted to Rs. 1,222.687 million (2025: Rs. 50.759 million), driven primarily by gains
recognized on the disposal of investments in subsidiaries. An exchange gain of Rs. 98.206 million (2025: loss of Rs.
95.055 million) was also recognized on the Company's outstanding Foreign Currency Convertible Bonds (FCCBs), on
account of the appreciation of the Pakistani Rupee against the US Dollar during the year, together with a gain of Rs.
42.522 million (2025: Rs. 5.708 million) from the change in fair value of investment property.
Finance cost reduced to Rs. 139.433 million from Rs. 188.716 million in the corresponding year, reflecting the
Company's ongoing debt management and deleveraging efforts, including the conversion of long‐outstanding liabilities
